name: stormiron
lore_descriptor: dark, with a faint blue cast and the smell of ozone
unidentified_descriptor: a heavy iron weapon that hums
first_pickup_chronicle: Stormiron. Quenched in a thunderhead while it cooled — the smith stood on a hilltop and held it up to the lightning. Half the smiths who try this die. The other half make this.
design_notes: Band B heavy rare_metal. Mult 1.40, weight 1.45, enchant 1. Players see stormiron and know what they're getting — heavy and brutal. Shock-resistant flavor lets the wielder shrug off some lightning-monster procs.
